name: enable_player_control

stack.evidence: func_001D1978 takes no Script context, clears bits 2 and 27 of D_002C1EA8, and does not access the value stack

notes: The controller update func_0012E398 treats global bit 2 as one of the state flags that suppresses its normal player-input path; command 115 sets that bit, while this command clears it and the associated transient bit 27. The JP corpus contains 305 calls. It is the event-cleanup inverse of command 115: 201 calls immediately follow command 112 show_party_status_ui, and 200 share an entry with a singular object-control enable through command 377.
